idea-plugin.name: CodeDuel
idea-plugin.description:
Compete head-to-head in private Java coding duels directly in IntelliJ IDEA.

  • Create a private room and share the room code with a friend.
  • Choose from 15 challenges and write your solution in the IntelliJ IDEA editor.
  • Run the public test cases, submit your solution for evaluation, and request a rematch.

To play online, open the CodeDuel tool window, select Configurar servidor… (Configure server), and enter wss://duel.alexdumitru.es/duel. Both players should use the same server.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial release of CodeDuel with private Java coding duels and automated solution evaluation.
